rows.name: po_due
rows.comments: Check-in due. Off unless the deployment sets has_proximal_outcomes (only mx does).

rows.name: po_due_type
rows.comments: Which check-in is due (same rule as home_screen_header). Written as the exact opposite of the 14-day row so a missing prox_14d_last_ts falls back to 7days.

rows.name: show_po
rows.comments: Set to true with set_local at hand-over; keeps the check-in on screen even when the timestamps change.

rows.name: po_active
rows.comments: keeps the check-in path on after 'due' turns false.

rows.name: articles
rows.comments: Same list name the module builds.

rows.name: po_start_article_id
rows.comments: Where the module opens: as now the first time, on its last page when coming back from the check-in.

rows.name: module_page_count
rows.comments: Number of module pages, passed to the check-in so its pages continue the module's bar.

rows.name: po_extra_steps
rows.comments: Number of check-in pages, passed to the module so its bar leaves room for them.

rows.name: module_start_at_id
module_start_at_id_checkin
rows.comments: when a check-in is due: same unlock data, then hands over to the check-in instead of closing.

rows.name: module_start_at_id
rows.comments: Reaches module › extra_steps through get_unlock › module_start_at_id.

rows.name: is_already_completed
rows.comments: Coming back the module counts as already completed (n_modules_completed isn't incremented again)

rows.name: po_return
rows.comments: Tells the module pages they were reopened from the check-in (close X shows the unlock pop-up)

rows.name: module_start_at_id_unlock_all
rows.comments: Reaches module › extra_steps through get_unlock › module_start_at_id_unlock_all

rows.name: proximal_outcome_page_7
rows.comments: Finishing or leaving the check-in closes the stack and shows the unlock pop-up the module would have shown.

rows.name: module_article_count
rows.comments: The check-in pages continue from the module's last page.

rows.name: proximal_outcome_page_14
module_article_count
rows.comments: The check-in pages continue from the module's last page.
